_about: Canonical vet report v2 fixtures (CUL-2285, VR2-4; critique MFU-1). One name per record, shared by docs/culprit-vet-report-v3-mockups.html round 5 and every v2 test (parity, extraction, the sheet 1 budget ratchet, the render guards). A test that needs a record uses one of these ids; a fixture marked 'to build' is created by the row named in builtBy, under this id, with the shape written here.
